whatAreCookies.title: What cookies are
whatAreCookies.description: Cookies and similar technologies are small data files stored on or read from your device when you visit the website or use the application. They may include cookies, local storage, session storage, pixel tags, and similar identifiers.

categories.title: Categories we use
categories.description: We may use the following categories:

items.essential: essential cookies for technical operation, security, and consent management,
items.functional: functional cookies to remember settings and preferences,
items.analytics: analytics cookies to measure traffic, performance, and use of the Service,
items.marketing: marketing cookies for personalization and campaign measurement, where deployed.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis for cookie use
legalBasis.description: We use necessary cookies because they are required for the functioning of the website or based on our legitimate interest in secure and proper operation. Optional cookies, especially functional, analytics, and marketing cookies, are used only on the basis of your consent unless law provides otherwise.

purposes.title: Purposes of cookie use
purposes.description: We use cookies in particular for:

items.analytics: analysis of traffic and use of the Service,
items.marketing: where applicable, marketing and campaign measurement.

thirdParties.title: Third parties
thirdParties.description: If we activate third-party services, cookies of those providers may be stored on or read from your device. This may typically include:
thirdParties.note: The exact scope of cookies used may change over time depending on the tools actually activated.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.description: Cookies may be session-based, meaning they are deleted after the browser is closed, or persistent, meaning they are stored for a certain period depending on purpose or provider settings. The specific retention period is stated in the cookie overview or cookie settings.

consentManagement.title: How you can manage consent
consentManagement.description: You can change your preferences or withdraw consent at any time through the “Cookie settings” link available on the website. Withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of prior processing.

browserSettings.title: Browser settings
browserSettings.description: You may also block or delete cookies through your browser. Some parts of the website or Service may then not function properly.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: If you have questions about our use of cookies, you can contact us at {email}.

controller.description: The controller of personal data is {company}, company ID {companyId}, with its registered office at {address}, email {email}, which operates the Service available at {domain}.

items.identification: identification data, such as first name, last name, company name, and company ID,

purposesAndLegalBases.description: We process personal data for the following purposes:

purposesAndLegalBases.legalBases: The legal basis is in particular:

thirdCountryTransfers.description: If personal data is transferred outside the European Economic Area, we do so only when the conditions set by GDPR are met, in particular on the basis of an adequacy decision, standard contractual clauses, or other appropriate safeguards.

retention.title: How long we retain data
retention.description: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the processing purpose. Typically:

items.contractual: contractual and billing data for the period required by law,
